purpose: Fail closed when a test couples an exact population count to live refreshed site/data. Scheduled first-class refresh rewrites those artifacts; exact pins force hand-restamping and block unattended merges.

permitted_shapes.summary: Load the population from a committed fixture under test/fixtures/ and keep exact asserts against that frozen vintage.

Assert a property that survives refresh: a non-empty floor that still fails on an empty set, a complement that sums to the whole, required keys, ordering, or equality between independently derived views of the same committed input.

scope.note: Governs exact-count asserts only when a test loads one of the listed refreshed site/data artifacts. Exact counts against committed fixtures are allowed. Grow this artifact list only when a later scheduled refresh proves another member.

empirical_starting_set.source: Scheduled first-class refresh pull request restamps that invalidated exact pins
